gloss: main part; principal section; core portion

definitions.gloss: main part; principal section; core portion
definitions.explanation: The central or most important part of a structure, document, machine, or system. Used to single out the essential portion from secondary or peripheral ones.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主要部|しゅようぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}した→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: The main part of the building is finished.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主要部|しゅようぶ}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read only the main part of the report.

examples.japanese: ⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主要部|しゅようぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不具合|ふぐあい}→不具合：06413_fuguai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかり→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧、⟦{復旧|ふっきゅう}→復旧：07521_fukkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: A fault was found in the core part of the system, and recovery took a long time.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{主要|しゅよう}→主要：01649_shuyou⟧ (main, principal) plus the suffix ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (part, section). It picks out the central portion of something composed of several parts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {主要部|しゅようぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{占|し}める→占める：11799_shimeru⟧: to make up the main part
- {主要部|しゅようぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}する→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧: the main part is completed
- ⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主要部|しゅようぶ}: the core of the system

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}→中心部：23774_chuushinbu⟧: central part — emphasizes physical or geographic center
- ⟦{根幹|こんかん}→根幹：07799_konkan⟧: backbone, core — the most fundamental basis, more abstract
